about: The twelve orchestration tools of HostLab's local gateway, read out of the frozen source. They are served by the `hostlab-remote` MCP server; the engine's own MCP server (`meguvizdexdash mcp`) and the legacy dexq server have other tools, some with overlapping names. The adapters keep this contract; they do not change it.

dispatch.evidence: each tool's dispatch class is checked against the calls it hands on when the frozen gateway runs (test_remote_runner_adapter.py::Registry); version_matrix_status hands on dispatch=False

frozen_extra_copy.about: Six more files of the frozen HostLab commit, in source-8782f43-extra (not the main copy the gateway tests load). Hashed here and verified equal to evidence/hostlab_integration_inventory.json. Their behaviour is still not executed by the controls (the gateway's calls into them are stubbed), except the two facts demonstrated below from the frozen source itself.

analysis_checkpoint_loader.meaning: HostLab's loader builds its own resume_origin from the run binding and overwrites the report's; its summary reads flat keys the adapter's nested lineage {seal, identity_sha256, origin, claim} does not have, so the adapter's lineage is its own chain, not consumed by HostLab's loader or summary

not_engine_tools.rule: a call is routed by (server, tool), never by the tool name: `query` is a tool of two servers and of neither orchestration call; the `operation` values of submit_job are arguments, not tools

not_in_the_frozen_copy.consequence: their behaviour is not executed by these controls (the gateway's calls into them are stubbed and recorded); the six in the frozen -extra copy are source evidence only, and version_matrix, remote_dispatch, runner_group, source_snapshot and adaptive_schedule were not obtained
not_in_the_frozen_copy.note: the main frozen copy the gateway tests load is source-8782f43; six of these modules are in the frozen source-8782f43-extra copy (see frozen_extra_copy), the rest were not obtained
